english_lines: O jasmine creeper dancing in the wind,
In our life joined by companionship,
O lord of desire, beautiful queen,
She surges in waves with love that overflows the dam,
The fire too is quenched; the breeze blows,
As nectar that never cloys, as sweet mango-fruit,
I have found a new life.
notes: `தேன் மதி` remains the concrete honeyed-moon image rather than becoming a generic beautiful moon.
The subject of `மாருதில் ஓடுதே` is not supplied on the page; English keeps the same open `it runs in the breeze` construction instead of inventing one.
`அணைமீறும் அன்பால் அலைமோதுகின்றாள்` keeps the dam-overflow and wave-surge imagery together.
`தேமாங்கனியாய்` is kept as sweet mango-fruit rather than softened to sweetness.

translator_notes: The translation retains Kalaignar's image-chain of sky-flower grove, honeyed moon, jasmine creeper, overflowing dam, quenched fire, breeze, nectar and mango-fruit.
This is a literary source-faithful translation, not a singable adaptation.
